static_traits.name: Lin Yuewen
static_traits.social_status: Relations with friends are affected, tends to avoid activities other than running or swimming, experiences a sense of isolation
static_traits.medical_history: Without significant physical illness; has not received psychotherapy in the past; without similar past psychological history
static_traits.language_features: Initially skeptical, but able to clearly describe experiences and feelings; tone rather negative; at the end of counseling expressing willingness to try small steps and self-compassion; cooperation fair

basic_info.main_problem: I feel I am only good at running and swimming, and am poor in all other areas.
basic_info.core_demands: I decided to seek counseling, after realizing these negative beliefs about my own abilities are affecting my motivation and willingness to try new things.
growth_experiences: Two years ago she failed a course at school and received negative feedback, with strong academic pressure and sense of failure at the time; since then the experience solidified into negative beliefs about her abilities (apart from running and swimming, I am bad at everything else), gradually affecting confidence and motivation, leading to self-doubt and avoiding new challenges in non-running, non-swimming areas; socially she avoids joining friends in unfamiliar activities; in daily life she has decreased motivation for self-care, often feels isolated, with low mood.

core_beliefs: I am incompetent(apart from running and swimming I am good at nothing)
One failure means my overall ability is low

special_situations.event: When friends invite her to activities unrelated to running or swimming
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I cannot excel in a new activity, others will see through my incapability and judge me
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Avoiding social invitations, reducing participation in unfamiliar activities
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will mess up; everyone will see I am no good

special_situations.event: Trying to learn a new skill or interest
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not succeed the first time, it proves I will never be any good at it
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: No longer trying; only sticking to running and swimming to maintain self-worth
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Once I fail it means I am good at nothing

special_situations.event: Planning to try a new recipe
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: If I do not do well I will fail and lose face
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Procrastinating or finding excuses not to start, avoiding new situations
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: I will definitely fail; no need to try

special_situations.event: Recalling failing a course two years ago and receiving negative feedback
special_situations.conditional_assumptions: One academic failure is enough to show my overall ability is insufficient; only achievements in running and swimming count as valuable
special_situations.compensatory_strategies: Mainly invests time and energy in running and swimming to maintain self-esteem, ignoring possible positive signs in other areas
special_situations.automatic_thoughts: Apart from running and swimming I am worthless

core_conflict.wish: Longing to be recognized and seen as capable, especially in new or unfamiliar areas
core_conflict.fear: Fearing failure being seen and judged by others, accompanied by shame and disappointment
defense_goal: Maintaining a sense of safety and self-worth by avoiding new things and performing only in familiar areas

behavioral_response_patterns.trigger_condition: When the counselor suggests choosing a small, manageable activity and practicing self-compassion and positive self-talk
behavioral_response_patterns.interpretation: The client tends to think these suggestions may expose her inadequacy, proving her failure again in front of others (projecting the past experience of 'being negatively evaluated' onto the current suggestions)
behavioral_response_patterns.response_instruction: Emphasizing worries and the possibility of failure in a cautious, reserved tone, using phrasing like 'this is hard for me''I might give up' to weaken commitment to action.

manifestations: Avoiding friend activities unrelated to running or swimming
Not opening up to supportive friends about feelings of incapability
Living alone, with fewer social connections
Negative beliefs limit freedom to choose and try new things
Fear of failure narrows behavioral choices
outcomes: Shrinking scope of life and experience
Self-worth bound by a single ability domain

contact_model.definition: The individual has a poor capacity for self-reflection and introspection, with excessive self-restriction and self-blame, and is overly cautious about contact.
manifestations: Hard to trust self; although willing to try, full of concerns
Focuses attention on potential mistakes and negative consequences

contact_model.definition: The individual restrains the impulse to act toward other people or objects, or gives up seeking others to do something for them and instead does it to themselves; that is, the individual redirects energy originally intended outward toward themselves.
manifestations: When talking about friend activities or new skills, pressing action impulses back into herself, turning them into self-criticism and procrastination
Coping with unfamiliar social situations through avoidance and withdrawal

positive_force: Has stable ability and self-discipline in running and swimming
In counseling, expresses willingness to try small, manageable steps and to practice self-compassion
Able to notice negative thinking and try to set small goals
negative_force: All-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, catastrophizing, and other negative cognitive patterns dominate
Core self-denial belief (apart from running and swimming I am good at nothing)
Avoidant behavior leads to restricted social life and increased sense of isolation, decreased motivation
Highly sensitive to external evaluation, not yet opening up to the support system

target_behavior.behavior: Avoiding new activities and tasks unrelated to running or swimming
antecedent: Encountering any unfamiliar tasks or activities
target_behavior.core_reason: The academic failure and negative feedback two years ago triggered and solidified the core belief of 'I am incapable', accompanied by all-or-nothing thinking, overgeneralization, and catastrophic anticipation, leading to high fear of failure and others' evaluations
target_behavior.function: Avoids potential failure and shame, avoids others' negative evaluations, maintaining short-term safety and self-esteem
target_behavior.consequence: Relationships with friends affected and reduced socializing, feeling isolated with low mood, decreased motivation for daily self-care, missing opportunities for growth and experience

target_behavior.behavior: Negative self-talk and self-labeling (e.g. 'I am good at nothing')
antecedent: Recalling academic failures and negative feedback
target_behavior.core_reason: Internalized core belief of self-denial and mental filtering, continuously reinforcing self-deprecation
target_behavior.function: Gaining short-term psychological comfort by lowering expectations and self-demands, avoiding the anxiety of trying and failing
target_behavior.consequence: Self-confidence is further weakened, avoidance behavior increases, and overall life satisfaction and participation decline
